papers.title_en: A Single Model for Glioblastoma Segmentation With and Without T2-FLAIR: Independent Validation of a Targeted Dropout Strategy
papers.tldr: 胶质母细胞瘤自动分割通常依赖完整MRI序列，但临床中T2-FLAIR缺失时性能下降。本文提出针对T2-FLAIR的定向dropout策略，训练模型同时适应有/无该序列的输入。独立验证显示，在缺少T2-FLAIR时仍保持高分割精度，且不影响完整协议下的性能，提升了临床适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Objectives: To evaluate targeted T2 fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (T2-FLAIR)dropout for robust automated glioblastoma segmentation and volumetry when T2-FLAIR is unavailable, while preserving performance when the full MRI protocol is …

papers.title_en: A Survey on Post-Training of Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.tldr: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的后期训练技术是提升其理解、推理与交互能力的关键环节。本文系统综述了MLLM后期训练的现有方法，涵盖指令微调、对齐优化、强化学习等核心策略，并分析了不同技术路线的优劣。综述总结了当前研究进展，指出现有方法在数据效率、泛化能力和计算成本上仍面临挑战，为未来研究提供了清晰的框架和方向。
papers.abstract_en: The technical evolution of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) hasprofoundly influenced the AI community, reshaping how intelligent systemsunderstand, reason, and interact in both the digital and physical worlds. Through …

papers.title_en: ARC-CT: Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Vision-Language Learning for 3D Chest CT
papers.tldr: 胸部CT体积与放射学报告之间的全局对比学习难以捕捉局部异常和解剖差异，从而限制无监督分类性能。ARC-CT提出解剖路由的对比视觉语言学习方法，利用解剖结构先验将CT体积划分为多个路由区域，并分别与报告中的对应文本片段进行对比对齐。该方法在胸部CT异常分类任务上优于全局对比学习基线，并缓解了配对数据不足与负样本噪声问题。其贡献在于将解剖先验引入医学图像-文本对比学习，提升了可解释性与样本效率。
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language learning uses paired chest CT volumes and radiologyreports to learn abnormality classifiers without manually annotated labels. However,two characteristics of chest CT challenge conventional global contrastive learning …

papers.title_en: Concept-Level Vision–Language Alignment for 3D CT: Linear Probing for the CVPR 2026 3D-CT FM Challenge
papers.tldr: 针对CVPR 2026 3D-CT基础模型挑战赛任务1（线性探测），我们需处理胸部与腹部CT中的17个二分类目标，数据呈现重度类别不平衡。方法上冻结预训练的3D视觉-语言模型Jolia，仅优化一个线性分类头，并引入类别平衡采样和自适应分类阈值以缓解小样本类别的偏差。在挑战赛All-Data Track的完整训练数据上，本方案取得了富有竞争力的表现，实证了概念级对齐的CT视觉特征在简单线性探测下便能有效泛化，为3D医学基础模型的表征质量评估提供了重要参考。
papers.abstract_en: This paper describes our submission to Task 1 (Linear Probing), All-Data Track, ofthe CVPR 2026 3D-CT Foundation Model Challenge, whose 17 binary targets spanchest and abdominal CT under heavy class imbalance. We freeze Jolia, a 3D vision …

papers.title_en: Dynamic Spectral Calibration Integrated with Diffusion Based Temporal Fusion for Accurate and Interpretable Hyperspectral Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.tldr: 针对高光谱脑肿瘤分割中光谱漂移和时序建模不足的问题，提出动态光谱校正与基于扩散的时间融合相结合的方法。通过动态校正消除光谱噪声，利用扩散模型融合多时相信息，实现高精度且可解释的分割。在脑肿瘤数据集上验证了有效性，显著提升准确率与可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: The segmentation of brain tumors, based on hyperspectral imaging (HSI), has beenattracting considerable interest for its capability of providing detailed spectral–spatialinformation about tissue. Current segmentation methods based on HSI have …

papers.title_en: Heart Failure Outcome Prediction Using Artificial Intelligence–enabled Coronary Artery Calcium CT Chamber Volumetry Compared to American Heart Association …
papers.tldr: 心衰风险预测对无症状人群的早期干预至关重要。传统评估多依赖临床指标，影像学应用有限。本研究探索人工智能（AI）从冠状动脉钙化（CAC）CT中自动提取心腔容积，并与美国心脏协会（AHA）传统方法比较，评估其对心衰结局的预测效能。结果表明，AI容积测量能有效改善风险分层，提供独立的预后信息，为临床提供无创、便捷的新工具。
papers.abstract_en: Purpose To evaluate whether artificial intelligence (AI)–derived chamber volumetryfrom coronary artery calcium (CAC) CT improves heart failure (HF) risk prediction.Materials and Methods This retrospective study included asymptomatic patients …

papers.title_en: Preoperative Spatial Risk Mapping of Glioblastoma Recurrence: A Radiomics-Based Framework for Surgical Planning
papers.tldr: 胶质母细胞瘤是恶性程度最高的脑肿瘤，即使采取最大安全切除和辅助放化疗，复发仍不可避免，且约90%的复发发生在原发灶周边2厘米范围内。常规MRI只能显示增强区域，低估了肿瘤的浸润范围。本文提出一种基于影像组学的术前空间风险映射框架，通过从多模态MRI中提取高维特征，并利用机器学习模型预测每个体素的复发概率，进而生成三维风险图谱。该框架可为手术规划提供个体化的切除边界，帮助外科医生在保护功能区和最大程度切除之间取得平衡，有望显著降低局部复发率。
papers.abstract_en: Glioblastoma recurrence remains nearly inevitable despite maximal resection andadjuvant therapy, with most relapses occurring within or adjacent to the originaltumor site. Conventional MRI underestimates tumor infiltration beyond contrast …

papers.title_en: Radiomics using generative adversarial network enhanced non-contrast computed tomography for gastric cancer diagnosis
papers.tldr: 非增强CT对胃癌诊断组织分辨率有限，而增强CT存在过敏和辐射风险。本研究提出用生成对抗网络增强非增强CT图像，并在此基础上进行放射组学分析。增强后的图像诊断性能显著提升，接近增强CT水平，同时避免了对比剂和额外辐射。该方法提供了一种安全、经济的胃癌诊断新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Non-contrast-enhanced CT (NCCT) images have limited tissue resolutionfor gastric cancer diagnosis, while contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) scans involve riskssuch as allergic reactions and high radiation exposure. This study proposes an …

papers.title_en: Why Only 3D for 3D? 2D-Guided Supervision for 3D Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.tldr: 3D医学视觉语言模型依赖配对体积扫描与专家标注，数据稀缺且昂贵。为缓解该问题，提出一种2D引导的监督策略，利用大量未标注3D扫描和丰富的2D标注或预训练知识来训练3D模型。该方法可有效提升模型性能并降低标注成本，为3D医学VLM训练提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Training 3D medical vision--language models (VLMs) requires paired volumetricscans and expert annotations such as reports or segmentation masks, which arecostly and limited. Meanwhile, large collections of unlabeled 3D scans and strong 2D …

papers.title_en: Z-Adapter: Parameter-Efficient 2.5 DLongitudinal Fusion for SAM2-Based Lung Tumor Segmentation in CT
papers.tldr: 可提示基础模型加速了医学图像分割，但直接在CT上逐切片应用2D模型会产生纵向闪烁，相邻切片肿瘤掩膜不稳定，导致体积测量误差。为此提出Z-Adapter，一种参数高效的2.5D纵向融合模块，用于基于SAM2的肺肿瘤分割。该方法仅引入少量可训练参数，通过跨切片上下文融合稳定掩膜序列，显著提升体积测量的准确性与一致性，为SAM2在CT三维场景中的可靠应用提供了轻量方案。
papers.abstract_en: Promptable foundation models have accelerated medical image segmentation, yetnaïvely applying 2D models slice-by-slice on CT often yields longitudinal flicker:unstable tumor masks across adjacent slices that degrade volumetric measurements …

papers.title_en: Reassessing Code Authorship Attribution in the Era of Language Models
papers.tldr: 代码风格计量学通过分析编码风格识别代码作者，对自动化软件工程至关重要。语言模型兴起后，机器生成的代码可能掩盖或模仿个体风格，传统作者归属方法面临可靠性挑战。本文在语言模型时代背景下重新评估代码作者归属技术，分析其受冲击程度并探索适应性调整。研究发现现有方法需要结合新的特征与评测基准，方能维持有效识别，对软件工程自动化具有重要参考价值。
papers.abstract_en: The study of Code Stylometry, and in particular Code Authorship Attribution (CAA),aims to analyze coding styles to identify the authors of code samples. CAA has beenillustrated to be an important component of automating software engineering (SE) …

papers.title_en: Addressing benchmarking gaps in large language models for health and medicine with dynamic red-teaming
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在医疗健康领域的应用日益广泛，但其安全性评估仍依赖静态基准，这些基准易过时且可能被优化。为此提出动态红队测试方法，持续生成新测试用例以暴露模型弱点。该方法可更准确评估模型真实能力，促进安全部署。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer health-relatedquestions and support healthcare workflows, yet evidence for their safety still reliesheavily on static benchmarks that can rapidly become obsolete or be optimized …

papers.title_en: Learning Anatomy-Grounded CT Vision-Language Representations with Organ-Hierarchical Report Knowledge
papers.tldr: 医学视觉语言预训练从配对CT和报告中学习，但现有方法要么整体对齐，要么局部对齐，缺乏解剖结构引导。本文提出器官层次报告知识嵌入，利用CT的解剖基础进行分层对齐，实现细粒度语义匹配。实验表明该方法在器官定位和疾病诊断等任务上优于基线，并提升可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language pretraining (VLP) from paired CT images and radiologyreports enables scalable representation learning, but most existing methods aligneither whole scans with entire reports or local image regions with text fragments …

papers.title_en: Fine-Grained Vision-Language Pretraining with Organ-Conditioned Pattern Tokens for CT Understanding
papers.tldr: CT影像与报告配对预训练面临全局对比掩盖局部细节的问题。提出一种基于器官条件模式令牌的细粒度视觉语言预训练方法，将器官信息嵌入令牌以增强对齐。方法在多个下游任务中显著提升性能，为医学影像理解提供了更精细的预训练范式。
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) vision-language pretraining from paired volumes andradiology reports is a scalable yet challenging task. Existing methods commonlyadopt global scan-report contrast, which is scalable but obscures heterogeneous …

papers.title_en: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
papers.tldr: 大语言模型后训练主要有强化学习和在线策略蒸馏两种范式，但强化学习依赖庞大的奖励模型和在线采样，成本高。本文提出了一种蒸馏强化学习方法，在保持强化学习效果的同时，利用蒸馏方式降低计算开销，提升训练效率，为后训练提供更实用的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning,adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms:reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on …

papers.title_en: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.tldr: 标准视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长复杂离线视觉推理，却在简单流式感知任务上表现不佳且处理低效，即莫拉维克悖论。为此，提出Mage-VL，一种codec-native的高效流式多模态基础模型，通过原生处理编码流来避免冗余解码，从而降低计算开销，提升流式感知的实时性与效率。该工作为流式多模态感知提供了一种高效的全新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Standard vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from Moravec's paradox: they excelat complex offline visual reasoning but struggle with simple streaming perceptiontasks and process them inefficiently. We present Mage-VL, an efficient codec-native …

papers.title_en: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.tldr: 现有基准多为整体评估，难以将视觉感知从推理、知识等能力中解耦，导致模型感知缺陷常被其他能力掩盖。PerceptionBench专门针对原子视觉感知设计，通过精细任务独立测量模型的基础视觉处理能力，并采用解耦评估指标。在多个主流多模态大模型上的实验显示，其基础感知准确率显著低于整体表现，暴露明显短板。该基准为系统诊断和提升MLLMs的感知瓶颈提供了标准化工具，有助于推动视觉基础研究。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PerceptionBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate theatomic visual perception capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models(MLLMs). Existing benchmarks often fail to isolate perception: holistic evaluations …

papers.title_en: Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning
papers.tldr: 随着大语言模型在复杂推理任务中的进步，它们越来越依赖输入中的显式条件。然而在常识推理中，这种机制导致显著偏差：模型偏向显著线索而忽略隐含常识。本研究设计了诸如'你愿意走路去洗车吗'的反常识问题，系统评估多种主流LLM。实验发现，模型普遍选择显式但不合理的选项，违背常理。该工作首次系统揭示并量化了这一偏差，为改进常识推理提供了评测与训练线索。
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks,they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input.However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical …

papers.title_en: Location-Aware Fine-Grained Representation Learning for Medical Vision Foundation Models
papers.tldr: 医学图像分析中，诊断证据常细微且局部化，现有视觉基础模型缺乏位置感知的细粒度表示。本文提出位置感知的细粒度表示学习方法，通过显式建模补丁级空间信息增强医学视觉编码器。在多个医学影像任务上验证了其提升细粒度识别与定位能力的有效性。该方法为医学基础模型提供了更具判别性的局部特征表示。

papers.title_en: CLIP-CC-Bench: Evaluating Paragraph-Level Video Descriptions in Video-Language Models
papers.tldr: 现有视频语言模型评测多聚焦短视频与单句描述，难以评估长段落描述的准确性。为此提出CLIP-CC-Bench基准，用于系统评测段落级视频描述生成。该基准通过细粒度跨模态对齐与事实一致性指标，对比多种模型性能。实验揭示当前模型在长描述中普遍存在细节遗漏与事实错误，为后续改进提供重要参考。
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking video-language models has largely focused on short clips and single-sentence metrics, leaving open whether current systems can generate accurate long-form, paragraph-level descriptions. We introduce CLIP-CC-Bench, an evaluation …

papers.title_en: EndoVLM: An Endoscopy Vision-Language Pre-training Model via Anatomy-Guided Sparsity and Progressive Alignment
papers.tldr: 内窥镜影像分析依赖基础模型，但现有内窥镜基础模型多从单模态图像或视频自监督学习，忽略了临床文本中丰富的语义知识。为此，本文提出EndoVLM，一种内窥镜视觉-语言预训练模型，通过解剖引导的稀疏注意力机制聚焦关键解剖结构，并采用渐进式对齐策略分阶段融合视觉与文本特征。该模型在多种内镜下游任务上取得显著性能提升，展现了视觉-语言预训练在医学影像领域的巨大潜力。
papers.abstract_en: The development of foundation models (FMs) is crucial for advancing endoscopicimage analysis. However, existing endoscopy FMs mainly rely on self-supervisedlearning from uni-modal images or videos, overlooking the rich semantic knowledge …

papers.title_en: Positive-Unlabeled Preference Optimization For Chest X-ray Report Generation
papers.tldr: 胸片报告生成中，视觉语言模型通常在回顾性临床报告上训练，但报告常遗漏细微阳性发现，如小气胸、轻微实变等，形成遗漏噪声，导致模型忽略重要病灶。为消除该噪声，本文提出正样本-未标记样本偏好优化方法：将已报告发现作为正样本，将未报告但可能存在的发现视为未标记样本，构造偏好对并优化排序损失，使模型学会优先生成具有临床意义的发现。在公开胸片数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著降低遗漏率，提升报告生成的完整性与准确性，超越多个先进基线，具有重要的临床医学应用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for radiology report generation are typically trainedon retrospective clinical reports, which suffer from omission noise: clinically presentfindings are left unreported due to the omission of subtle findings. For example, prior …

papers.title_en: DistMedVL: Distributional Vision-Language Alignment for Uncertainty-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
papers.tldr: 医学图像分割中，视觉与文本跨模态对齐是多模态理解的基础，但临床影像与报告常含噪声、模糊等不确定性，现有对齐方法多采用确定性嵌入，难以表达这种不确定性，导致分割性能与可靠性下降。为此，提出DistMedVL，将视觉与文本特征建模为概率分布，通过分布化对齐最小化双模态分布差异，并利用不确定性估计自适应加权区域损失。在多个医学图像分割基准上，该方法在精度、Dice系数和不确定性校准上均优于现有方法，为可靠临床辅助诊断提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal alignment of visual and textual representations is fundamental tomultimodal medical image understanding, yet remains hindered by uncertainty inboth modalities under real-world clinical conditions. Existing vision-language …

papers.title_en: Curia-MAE: Multi-Modal Multi-Anatomy MAE Pre-Training for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.tldr: 放射学基础模型虽能通过冻结编码器适配下游任务，但对3D分割等密集预测任务支持不足。Curia-MAE提出多模态、多解剖部位的MAE预训练方法，在多种影像和器官上学习通用表示。实验表明其在下游3D分割任务上仅需微调小层即可取得优异性能，填补了该领域空白。
papers.abstract_en: Radiology foundation models learn transferable representations that can be adaptedto new tasks by training only small layers on top of a frozen encoder. Denseprediction tasks such as 3D segmentation are, however, underrepresented in their …

papers.title_en: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
papers.tldr: 奖励建模正从判别式转向生成式，但生成式奖励模型虽具备强排序能力，却未在强化学习中充分发挥作用。本文提出基于排序的奖励构建方法RRC，将生成式奖励模型的排序信号转化为可用的奖励函数，从而在LLM强化学习中实现性能提升。该方法为利用生成式奖励模型的潜力提供了新路径。
